"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"States should be empowered to allow a wide array of accrediting and credentialing bodies to operate.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Decoupling accreditation from federal financing and empowering states would foster innovation.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Decoupling accreditation from federal financing and empowering states would bring private industry into the credentialing market.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Insurance premiums have dramatically increased under the Affordable Care Act of 2010.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Deductibles have risen about eight times faster than wages in the last ten years under the Affordable Care Act of 2010.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act of 2010 drove up drug prices by levying a $27 billion tax on manufacturers and importers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act of 2010 forced pharmaceutical companies to raise prices for everyone else through mandated price cuts for drugs under Medicare and Medicaid.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act of 2010's \"silver plans\" limit people's access to their own doctor through narrow networks.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act of 2010's \"silver plans\" restrict drug coverage, forcing many patients to pay for extremely costly medicines for their chronic diseases.",
